title: CaliaCorp 3: Project Succu8u5
description:
In part three of the series, CaliaCorp learned all about your kinks and fantasies. Now you have made it to the part of CaliaCorp you came to find. But can you remember why you were even looking for it? Does it matter? You're a part of it now, as the helpful lab assistant shows you where to go. As you're shown the way into your CaliaCorp work pod. Don't be concerned about the door shutting. Just put on the headphones, and listen.

Soon you'll be part of Project Succu8u5. Soon you'll understand why you came, and what you're here for now. For pleasure. To feel the incredible power of working for CaliaCorp, and to give us all your energy in pursuit of a better tomorrow. It's time to surrender to your position, employee. It's time to give in, once and for all.
